In the case of the verb धारि 'to owe', the creditor is called सम्प्रदान।

Terms: कारक-सम्प्रदान

The affix ठक् comes after the word धर्मं being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'who practices that'.

Terms: ठक्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'not deviating there from' after the words 1. धर्म 2. पथिन् 3. अर्थ and 4. न्याय ।

Terms: यत्

The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् (to the exclusion of others) after nominal steps ending in 1. धर्म 2. शील 3. वर्ण।

Terms: इनि (इन्)

The affix अनिच् (अन्) comes after the word धर्म when it is the last member of a बहुव्रीहि समास and is itself the only word without any other word joined with it or when the first member is a single word.

Terms: अनिच् (अन्)
